Traitement Indice acoustique
Import sur un DF différent de tout les indices et audio de 10 minutes
```{r}
chemin <- "~/Césure/Tahiti/Data_IA_Tahiti_10m_Pro"
fichiers_xlsx <- list.files(
  chemin,
  pattern = "\\.xlsx$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
IA_10m_0.3_8Khz <- lapply(fichiers_xlsx, read_excel)
IA_10m_0.3_8Khz  <- bind_rows(lapply(fichiers_xlsx, read_excel))
```

Pour DF_IA10 : Simplification des Dataset pour avoir des indices acoustiques par fichier, 1 par ligne, on nettoie l'indice ACI pour n'avoir que la valeur principale pour un fichier (pas par fréquence de 1000 Hz). on supprimer les colonnes créé vide avec les NA
```{r}
IA_10m_0.3_8Khz <- IA_10m_0.3_8Khz %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Enr = projet)

IA_10m <- IA_10m_0.3_8Khz %>%
  group_by(Enr, fichier) %>%
  summarise(
    ACI = first(ACI_val),
    ADI = first(ADI_val.adi_left),
    AEI  = first(AEI_val.aei_left),
    BIO  = first(BIO_val.left_area),
    H = first(H_val),
    M = first(M_val),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
#On rajoute les variables principales pour chaque ligne  d'indice pour les fichiers analysés
DF_IA10 <- IA_10m %>%
  left_join(
    Data_Globale_Tahiti,
    by = "Enr"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Fichier,
         -EAA)
```

Centré_réduire les variables de communauté pour modélisation
```{r}
DF_IA10_sc <- DF_IA10 %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(S, S_Exo),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.)),
      .names = "{.col}_sc"
    )
  )
```

x6 modèle pour chaque variable de communautés avec les indices acoustiques
```{r}
mod_ADI_S <- lmer(
  ADI ~ S_sc+(1 | Commune/Enr),
  data = DF_IA10_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)
mod_ACI_S <- lmer(
  ACI ~ S_sc+(1 | Commune/Enr),
  data = DF_IA10_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)
mod_AEI_S<- lmer(
  AEI ~ S_sc+(1 | Commune/Enr),
  data = DF_IA10_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)
mod_BIO_S <- lmer(
  BIO ~ S_sc+(1 | Commune/Enr),
  data = DF_IA10_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)
mod_H_S <- lmer(
  H ~ S_sc+(1 | Commune/Enr),
  data = DF_IA10_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)
mod_M_S <- lmer(
  M ~ S_sc+(1 | Commune/Enr),
  data = DF_IA10_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)

summary(mod_ADI_S)
car::Anova(mod_ADI_S)
summary(mod_ACI_S)
car::Anova(mod_ACI_S)
summary(mod_AEI_S)
car::Anova(mod_AEI_S)
summary(mod_BIO_S)
car::Anova(mod_BIO_S)
summary(mod_H_S)
car::Anova(mod_H_S)
summary(mod_M_S)
car::Anova(mod_M_S)
```
Exportation des tableaux de modèles linéaires + Anova, à faire après l'analyse du modèle car plusieurs modèles ont le même noms de variable pour simplifier les choses entre S, S_Exo, PA_Natif et PA_Myna (tous mod_ADI_S par exemple)
```{r}
models <- list(
  mod_ADI_S = mod_ADI_S,
  mod_ACI_S = mod_ACI_S,
  mod_AEI_S = mod_AEI_S,
  mod_BIO_S = mod_BIO_S,
  mod_H_S   = mod_H_S,
  mod_M_S   = mod_M_S
)
format_pvalue <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.0001, 
         "0.0001",
         format(round(p, 4), nsmall = 4))
}
add_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    p < 0.1   ~ ".",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}
table_final <- imap_dfr(models, function(mod, name) {
  
  tidy(mod, effects = "fixed") %>%
    mutate(
      Model = name,
      AIC = round(AIC(mod), 1),
      Estimate = round(estimate, 3),
      Std_Error = round(std.error, 3),
      df = round(df, 2),
      t_value = round(statistic, 3),
      p_raw = p.value,
      p_value = format_pvalue(p.value),
      stars = add_stars(p.value),
      p_display = paste0(p_value, " ", stars)
    ) %>%
    select(Model,
           Community_factor = term,
           AIC,
           Estimate,
           Std_Error,
           df,
           t_value,
           p_display)
})
write_xlsx(table_final, "Resultats_LMM_IA_S.xlsx")
```
```{r}
models <- list(
  mod_ADI_S = mod_ADI_S,
  mod_ACI_S = mod_ACI_S,
  mod_AEI_S = mod_AEI_S,
  mod_BIO_S = mod_BIO_S,
  mod_H_S   = mod_H_S,
  mod_M_S   = mod_M_S
)
format_pvalue <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.0001,
         "0.0001",
         format(round(p, 4), nsmall = 4))
}
add_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    p < 0.1   ~ ".",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}
anova_table <- imap_dfr(models, function(mod, name) {
  
  aov_res <- car::Anova(mod, type = 2)
  
  as.data.frame(aov_res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Community_factor") %>%
    mutate(
      Model = name,
      AIC = round(AIC(mod), 1),
      Chisq = round(Chisq, 3),
      Df = Df,
      p_value = format_pvalue(`Pr(>Chisq)`),
      stars = add_stars(`Pr(>Chisq)`),
      p_display = paste0(p_value, " ", stars)
    ) %>%
    select(Model,
           Community_factor,
           AIC,
           Chisq,
           Df,
           p_display)
})
write_xlsx(anova_table, "Resultats_ANOVA_IA_S.xlsx")
```

```{r}
      p_display = paste0(p_value, " ", stars)
    ) %>%
    select(Model,
           Community_factor = term,
           AIC,
           Estimate,
           Std_Error,
           df,
           t_value,
           p_display)
})
write_xlsx(table_final, "Resultats_LMM_IA_NE.xlsx")
```
```{r}
models <- list(
  mod_ADI_NE = mod_ADI_NE,
  mod_ACI_NE = mod_ACI_NE,
  mod_AEI_NE = mod_AEI_NE,
  mod_BIO_NE = mod_BIO_NE,
  mod_H_NE   = mod_H_NE,
  mod_M_NE   = mod_M_NE
)
format_pvalue <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.0001,
         "0.0001",
         format(round(p, 4), nsmall = 4))
}
add_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    p < 0.1   ~ ".",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}
anova_table <- imap_dfr(models, function(mod, name) {
  
  aov_res <- car::Anova(mod, type = 2)
  
  as.data.frame(aov_res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Community_factor") %>%
    mutate(
      Model = name,
      AIC = round(AIC(mod), 1),
      Chisq = round(Chisq, 3),
      Df = Df,
      p_value = format_pvalue(`Pr(>Chisq)`),
      stars = add_stars(`Pr(>Chisq)`),
      p_display = paste0(p_value, " ", stars)
    ) %>%
    select(Model,
           Community_factor,
           AIC,
           Chisq,
           Df,
           p_display)
})
write_xlsx(anova_table, "Resultats_ANOVA_IA_NE.xlsx")
```
